$comment: Person Attribute Search question bank for the PAS pass of Visual Attribute Search, aligned to the legacy vad_pseudo_labelling_pipeline v1.0.0 PEOPLE_CAPTION_PROMPT. Run once per track over that track's crops (visual_qa.track_crops_sidecar). Categorical attributes use closed option vocabularies copied verbatim from v1.0.0; hard_* are retrieval queries consumed by the person_attribute_search stage.

questions.question: What is the person's age group? child = under 13, teenager = 13-19, adult = 20-64, senior = 65 or older.
What is the person's gender?
What is the person's skin tone?
What is the person's body shape?
What is the person's hair length?
What is the person's hair style?
What is the person's hair color?
What is the sleeve length of the outer top?
What is the outer top garment type?
What is the outer top color?
What is the sleeve length of the inner top?
What is the inner top garment type?
What is the inner top color?
What is the bottom length?
What is the bottom garment type?
What is the bottom color?
What is the shoe type?
What is the shoe color?
Is the person wearing headwear?
What is the headwear type?
What is the headwear color?
Is the person wearing a face mask?
Is the person wearing glasses?
List carried objects (e.g. bag, handbag, backpack, messenger bag), comma-separated. Use an empty string if nothing is carried.
What is the person's motion or action?
Is the person involved in a potential anomaly?
If there is a potential anomaly, what type is it?
List visible accessories or carried objects as tuples (relationship, primary_color, item), e.g. [("wearing", "yellow", "hard hat"), ("carrying", "black", "backpack")]. Use [] when none are visible.
Are the attributes consistent across the different views of this person?
What is the image quality of these crops?

Write a caption describing this person's clothing (type, length, style, color for upper and lower body), shoes, headwear, accessories, and any visible logos, graphics, or patterns. Describe only visible attributes; do not mention absent features.
Write a detailed retrieval description (max 15 words) of this person emphasizing clothing, patterns, and logos. Do not include age or gender.
Write another detailed retrieval description (max 15 words) of this person emphasizing accessories and hair. Do not include age or gender.
